correctness.rationale: Induction by leaf attachment + canonical free-tree code enumerates exactly 5447 nonisomorphic trees through 14 vertices; Cayley–Hamilton gives 2n-term finite criterion for equality of the infinite walk profiles. Rooted tree-DP exactly computes all hom(F,T) and finite source census (11 trees of order 7). An independently written NetworkX free-tree enumeration, independent walk-profile and hom recursion produced nine profile-colliding pairs (1 at n12, 2 at n13, 6 at n14), found both six-vertex resolving probes through n13 and exactly two seven-vertex resolving probes through n14. Exceptional 14-vertex pair indistinguishable by all sources with ≤6 vertices and separable by S(1,1,4), S(1,2,3), proving sharpness within the stated finite universe. No inference beyond n14.
residual_risks: Exhaustiveness is over target n≤14 and tree source n≤7; there is no universal all-order claim.
